title: No word searches note bodies: a path or run id cited only in an item's notes cannot be found across the project
outcome: An agent can find every open item whose notes cite a given text, such as a worktree path or a launcher run id, without walking show --notes over every item
acceptance: A search route (the search word, ls --search, or a new filter) matches case-insensitive text in note and gate bodies of open items, not only refs, titles, outcomes and labels, and says so in its description
A test covers a path-like citation such as .worktrees/NAME/target/tmp/file appearing only in a note body being found, and the CLI/MCP contract documents the widened scope

completion.summary: CLI ls and MCP search now find complete canonical note/gate text and refs, with deterministic bounded locator/family overlays, literal Unicode matching, eligible-scope isolation and shared snapshot/count/page membership. Full gate passed; required Codex+Claude reviews have no Medium-or-higher findings, all five Lows tracked; authority concurrence/notice/audit satisfied; independent acceptance d3a75831 passed both criteria. Exact clean release installed with backup, all four stores ready, remote master verified at landed commit.
